Title: Rapid Response Crew
Description: Network faults can be repaired quickly using spare parts held directly by utility staff

Title: Physical Hardening
Description: Access to facility premises is restricted with locks, fences, and other physical barriers

Title: Backup Water Supply
Description: The utility can quickly supply water from its own storage tanks if the main pipeline "runs dry"

Title: Drone Assistance
Description: Drones can be used in difficult terrain to locate the source of a fault or disruption

Title: Backup Power
Description: Critical operations are maintained using battery banks or backup generators

Title: Back to Basics
Description: Facility staff and on-call personnel can operate the plant manually

Title: Valve Locks
Description: Critical valves are fitted with locks that can only be opened with a specialized key

Title: Redundant Pipelines
Description: Water can be routed into the distribution network through more than one pipeline

Title: Backup Contractors
Description: Pre-mapped alternative contractors are available to step in for key subcontractors

Title: Motion Detectors
Description: Unauthorized activity triggers alerts to utility staff or a security company

Title: Switch to Manual Mode
Description: Automation is switched off until the attacker has been confirmed out of the systems

Title: Air-Gapped Systems
Description: Automation systems are completely disconnected from the internet and office network

Title: Backup Restoration
Description: Up-to-date system backups exist and restoring from them has been practiced

Title: Multi-Factor Authentication
Description: In addition to passwords, a second verification step such as a one-time code is required

Title: Network Segmentation
Description: Automation systems are clearly separated from other utility or municipal IT networks

Title: Cyber Drills
Description: Staff regularly practice recognizing threats such as phishing attacks

Title: Latest Updates
Description: Security patches and updates are installed on systems as soon as they become available

Title: Encrypted Frequencies
Description: Only encrypted connections are used for radio communications

Title: Smart Remote Access
Description: Remote access is restricted strictly to specific approved devices or networks

Title: External Specialists
Description: An external cybersecurity provider analyzes the utility's systems to confirm a suspected attack

Title: Official Channels
Description: Information is shared through official channels communicated to customers in advance

Title: Trusted SMS Sender
Description: Text messages are sent to customers from a recognized number that does not raise suspicion

Title: Transparency Campaign
Description: Daily utility operations are communicated openly through local media

Title: Extended Comms Team
Description: Utility staff receive support from municipal employees to answer customer inquiries

Title: Water Utility Live
Description: Real-time updates on incident resolution are published on the utility's website

Title: Local Influencers
Description: Respected local figures help share verified information within their community networks

Title: Press Releases
Description: Pre-made templates allow press releases to be distributed quickly to relevant stakeholders

Title: Identity Protection
Description: Security services are offered to staff and customers to limit misuse of personal data

Title: Legal Action
Description: Perpetrator(s) are visibly prosecuted in court

Title: External Support
Description: Call health authorities and ask them to publish an official public notice

Title: Phone a Friend
Description: Call local customers in the area to check on tap water quality

Title: E-Invoicing
Description: Encourage customers to switch to electronic invoicing

Title: Just Fix It
Description: Go on-site and manually turn the valve back open

Title: Cooperative Governance
Description: Water pricing is addressed openly in cooperative meetings accessible to all members

Title: Data Minimization
Description: Only customer data strictly required for billing is stored

Title: Top Reputation
Description: The utility continuously maintains its public reputation, reducing suspicion during rumors

Title: Local Social Media
Description: Situational updates are posted directly into local social media groups

Title: Local Radio
Description: Information is provided to local radio stations to broadcast to the community

Title: Verification Protocol
Description: Clear rules are agreed upon regarding who can submit requests and how those requests are verified

Title: Offline Backups
Description: Important utility documents are backed up outside of computer hard drives
